title: Do Your Homework
coreMove: Prepare enough that the first exchange proves attention rather than appetite.
sourcePressure: Preparation is the baseline of respectful connection: research makes questions relevant and keeps access from being wasted.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning homework into robotic stalking, trivia-dropping, or a pretext for showing off.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source sidecar gives no named people, studies, places, or artifacts for this chapter beyond title and conceptual support; use fictional examples only.

hook: You need better networking, not more contacts
A calendar full of meetings is not a network
At 8:00 a.m., a professional walks into a room and learns a lesson
counterintuition: Networking is not about quantity; it is about quality
The strongest relationship is not the one with the most status
Most people think relationships are soft skills
tryThisNow: Set a 60-second timer and list three people
Send one message right now with no context
Write down your network and rank it
examples: conference badge swap with no stakes
LinkedIn message to a famous stranger

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches repeated phrases but not the deeper template of timestamp plus named protagonist plus prop plus decision that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm through a question to the reader, a research-free aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical/profile reference when a frozen anchor exists
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
